outcome: Vertical transmission of COVID-19 to neonates (neonatal RT-PCR, neonatal IgM/IgG serology)
cohort: The study included 90 pregnant patients with confirmed COVID-19 infection who reported to a military hospital in Rawalpindi, Pakistan, during May-June 2020.
finding: The study found no evidence of vertical transmission of COVID-19 from infected pregnant mothers to neonates, as all tested neonates were COVID-19 negative by RT-PCR and serology.
